ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75-80% high-intensity white pixels and 20-25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the trailing edges; high-density dark mottling in the medial region of the left lobe; large-scale yellowish-tan contiguous blobs concentrated on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate vertex angle of 35 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations is highest at the distal lobes, exhibiting irregular jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (dark outlines on white background) densely packed in the central-left lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, fine-line pixel disruptions appearing as dark scratches on the white pigmentation of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, dark, irregular textured masses at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive yellowish biological staining across the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetrical brown-toned pigmentation patch localized to the right lobe's inner quadrant.
